description: This file defines the CRDevTools class which manages preferences for Chromium DevTools integration, including reading and writing preferences to a JSON file, and intercepting DevTools embedder methods.

classes.name: CRDevTools
classes.description: A class that intercepts preferences-related DevTools embedder methods and manages preferences stored in a JSON file.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes CRDevTools with the preferences file path.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Sets up event listeners and scripts in the DevTools session to handle preferences and messaging.

methods.name: _save
methods.description: Serializes and writes preferences to the file, ensuring no corruption.
